# HTTP fixtures

Small, hand-checked provider responses used with `respx` in the default suite.

- `ollama_*`: shapes of Ollama 0.12 `/api/chat` (non-streaming) and `/api/show` responses, trimmed to the
  fields hone-models reads. `ollama_chat_thinking_only.json` is the OneShotStudio failure: a thinking
  model returning empty `content` with filled `thinking`.
- `openai_*`: OpenAI `/v1/chat/completions` shapes (incl. `logprobs.content[].top_logprobs`).
- `jev_*`: **unverified**. The Jev (TypeSafe AI) API shape is reconstructed from public articles
  (Sept 2026); see `src/hone_models/providers/jev.py`.
- `jev_decide_ok.json`: a Jev `/decide` response in the reconstructed (unverified) shape, with one
  per-question error.
- `openai_decide_logprobs.json`: an OpenAI-compatible reply answering one yes/no question as JSON, with
  token logprobs whose tokens spell out exactly the content (generated by hand; `yes` vs `no` at the answer
  token gives P(yes) ≈ 0.90 while the stated confidence is 0.6).
